fields.label: Category
fields.description: Blank means the whole book. Set it to carry a category target beside the overall one - a rep can be at 110% overall and at 48% on tea, and only the second is worth a conversation.

fields.label: Target
fields.description: Read in the unit the type implies: rupees for Value, base units for Volume, a count for the three counting types, and lines per productive call for the last one.

fields.label: Additive
fields.description: Set from the type, never by hand. An additive target is split among the children when it cascades; a ratio is copied to each of them unchanged. Stored rather than re-derived so a cascade can be read back and checked a year later against the rule that was in force when it ran.
